channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Debate na Band: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro se enfrentam antes do 2º turno
item.description: Lula arrived at the Band debate accompanied by Janja and said he hopes proposals can be debated. He stated he does not know if experience will make a difference and criticized the impoverishment of Brazilian politics. The president highlighted that he travels the country and uses television to convince voters.

item.title: Em Paris, apoiadores de Lula reivindicam o verde-amarelo e pedem votos no segundo turno
item.description: Lula's supporters gathered in Paris to mobilize votes for the runoff, claiming the green and yellow after pro-democracy demonstrations across Brazil.

item.title: Lobista põe Lulinha na marca do pênalti, e Flávio Bolsonaro chuta
item.description: Lulinha, investigated for influence peddling, became a liability to his father Lula during the 2026 election campaign, drawing criticism. Flávio Bolsonaro leveraged the issue to attack the PT, escalating tensions between the two sides. The episode underscores the role of lobbyists and politicians' children in the electoral race.

item.title: Que horas é o debate da Band? Veja horário, regras e como assistir ao primeiro confronto entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The first presidential debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro takes place at 8 PM on TV Band, also broadcast on other media. The format includes three blocks with moderator questions, direct confrontations, and closing statements. The second debate is scheduled for October 23rd on Globo.

item.title: “Band” instala grades para separar apoiadores de Lula e Flávio
item.description: Band installed barriers to separate supporters of Lula and Flávio outside its headquarters during the presidential debate promoted by the network. The gathering takes place one week before the second round of voting, scheduled for October 25, 2026.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula fazem ato com Caetano Veloso, Djavan e outros artistas em Copacabana
item.description: Supporters of Lula held the 'Musical Act for Democracy' in Copacabana, promoting democracy and conscious voting ahead of the runoff. Artists like Caetano Veloso, Djavan, and Xamã combined music and political speeches.

item.title: Por que o TSE mudou 2.000 seções eleitorais agora e quais as regiões mais afetadas
item.description: The TSE changed 2,000 polling stations due to adverse weather conditions and venue issues, with the Northeast region being most affected. Voters can check their polling stations on the TSE website or via the e-Título app.

item.title: Lula pede ao TSE alerta de seções alteradas e transporte a eleitores
item.description: Lula's coalition 'Brasil Pronto Pra Mais' requested urgent measures from the TSE to ensure free public transportation and individual notification for voters whose polling sections were changed for the runoff election, claiming that communication via websites and apps only increased abstention in the first round.

item.title: Moro quer proteção policial para amiga de Lulinha
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro announced he will request police protection for businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, who declared fearing for her and her daughters' safety. In a social media video, Moro advocated for an investigation into the accusations made by Luchsinger against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é investigado em 2º inquérito no STF para apurar suspeitas de lavagem com advogado
item.description: The Federal Police sent a new inquiry to the STF investigating Flávio Bolsonaro over money laundering suspicions tied to lawyer Willer Tomaz and the Rede Loto. The case was assigned to Minister Alexandre de Moraes and raises to two the inquiries against the senator at the STF.

item.title: Ato de Flávio reúne 76.200 na Paulista a uma semana do 2º turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign rally on Paulista Avenue gathered around 76,200 people, according to Poder360's estimate. It was the largest pro-Bolsonaro turnout at the location since Jair Bolsonaro's event in February 2024. The rally took place one week before the first round of the 2026 presidential elections.

item.title: Senador Marcos Pontes quer impedir ex-ministros do STF de disputar eleições
item.description: Senator Marcos Pontes (PL-SP) introduced a bill barring Supreme Court justices from running for office for eight years after leaving the bench, including retroactively for those still within the window. The measure amends the Ineligibility Law to prevent misuse of institutional influence in future candidacies.

item.title: Lula x Flávio para presidente: o que dizem as pesquisas e a agenda de novos levantamentos
item.description: A week before the runoff, polls show a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, each with 50% of valid votes. The race remains tight, and new polls are expected to update the electoral scenario ahead of Sunday's vote.

item.title: Autor do pedido de impeachment de Dilma faz o “L” em apoio a Lula
item.description: Jurist Miguel Reale Júnior, author of the impeachment request against Dilma Rousseff, declared support for Lula's re-election to preserve democracy. Reale also announced his vote against Flávio Bolsonaro, arguing that his victory would threaten democracy and could lead to amnesty for those involved in the January 8 attacks. The campaign encourages Lula supporters to use national symbols to dispute the narrative on social media.

item.title: Flávio é retrocesso, diz mãe de Paulo Gustavo, que viu Bolsonaro rir
item.description: Paulo Gustavo's mother publicly criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro, saying his surname reminds her of her son who died from COVID-19, and urges voting for Lula to prevent a return to the pandemic-era government. The piece highlights the CPI investigation into Bolsonaro and the failures in vaccine access and public health during the pandemic.

item.title: Os eleitores que decidem o 2º turno, segundo cartilha da campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula's campaign strategy focuses on mobilizing 40% of first-turn abstainers and attracting Cury voters. The plan combines voter turnout incentives, direct engagement with moderate urban voters, and targeted media messaging.

item.title: Janones cancela ida a ato para ajudar Lula em debate
item.description: Federal congressman André Janones (Rede-MG) canceled his participation in a pro-Lula rally in Rio to join the president during a Band debate. He emphasized analyzing arguments from both sides and highlighted his over 5 million WhatsApp followers as 'democracy soldiers.' The debate will be the first direct face-off between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the campaign, amid a context of event cancellations and candidate absences.

item.title: Advogado rebate Richarlison sobre ilha em Angra e dá prazo de 72 horas para jogador apresentar documentos
item.description: Lawyer Willer Tomaz rejected accusations from footballer Richarlison regarding a land dispute over an island in Angra dos Reis, denying any irregularities and challenging the player to present documents proving the purchase and payment of R$10 million. Tomaz gave 72 hours to submit a deed or payment proof, promising to transfer property rights for free if valid. He also questioned the amount cited by the athlete, claiming that a company linked to Richarlison had indicated a value of R$2.6 million, and noted that police and prosecutors closed the investigation due to lack of criminal evidence.

item.title: TSE manda vice de Flávio apagar vídeo que liga Lula ao crime
item.description: The TSE ordered Flávio's running mate, Alfredo Gaspar, to remove a video linking Lula to organized crime, citing irregular electoral propaganda. The post used a report on the killing of businessman Fred Williams to suggest criminal support for Lula without factual basis. This marks the second removal order against Lula within the same week.

item.title: Candidato a vice de Flávio Bolsonaro aciona Justiça contra Manuela D’Ávila
item.description: Vice-presidential candidate Alfredo Gaspar filed an electoral complaint against Manuela D'Avila for an alleged rape accusation made during a pro-Lula rally. The accusation occurred days after the Supreme Court dismissed the original complaint. Gaspar requests removal of the post and investigation for defamation.

item.title: Veja fotos do ato de Flávio Bolsonaro na Avenida Paulista, em São Paulo
item.description: Supporters of Flávio Bolsonaro occupied Paulista Avenue in a pre-election rally with a carnival-like atmosphere and anti-PT speeches. Right-wing leaders attended, with rhetoric favoring alliances with international figures and criticism of the PT.

item.title: Veja fotos do ato em apoio a Lula na Esplanada dos Ministérios, em Brasília
item.description: Supporters of President Lula held a rally at the Ministries Esplanade in Brasília one week before the runoff. The president did not attend, focusing on preparing for the debate with Flávio Bolsonaro. The mobilization included social movements, students, and GDF candidate Leandro Grass, who defended Lula and criticized Celina Leão.

item.title: Lições do passado e do Centrão servem de alerta a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) faces a reality_check after the first_round of the presidential race, as the Centrão, led by Hugo Motta and Davi Alcolumbre, resists the renewal of terms and supports conservative agenda items. Despite winning the popular vote over Lula, recent polls show a technical tie between the two candidates, warning of the need for negotiation and alliances to pass future legislative initiatives.

item.title: Atiradores de elite acompanharam ato de Flávio na av. Paulista
item.description: Elite shooters from PM-SP monitored Flávio Bolsonaro's rally on Avenida Paulista, one day after a pro-Lula demonstration in the same location. The event gathered figures like Tarcísio de Freitas and Ricardo Nunes, but police did not comment on security actions. Lula's team was authorized to use drones, while Poder360 faced restrictions.

item.title: Snipers no alto de prédios chamam atenção durante comício de Flávio Bolsonaro na Paulista
item.description: Military snipers positioned on buildings during Flávio Bolsonaro's rally on Paulista Avenue sparked controversy, with the police citing protocol-based security measures. The 'Bloc 22' event gathered approximately 72,000 people and featured right-wing leaders such as Tarcísio de Freitas and Ricardo Nunes.

item.title: TSE fará ‘intensivão’ para julgar candidatos suspeitos de ligação com o crime organizado
item.description: The TSE launched an accelerated trial process to review candidates linked to organized crime, including investigations into figures such as Márcio Canella and Flávio Bolsonaro. The court also set boundaries for political attacks between Lula and Bolsonaro regarding allegations of ties to gangs and militias.

item.title: Pivô de escândalo no INSS, Roberta Luchsinger diz que sabe mais do que já revelou
item.description: Lawyer Roberta Luchsinger claims in a new video that she has more information about the alleged corruption scheme involving President Lula and his son Fábio Luís than she previously disclosed. She is under investigation in three federal police inquiries and denies lying, asserting she has proof of the alleged corrupt meetings. President Lula previously called her a 'swindler' and denies any connection to her.

item.title: Apoiadores de Flávio Bolsonaro levam míssil inflável com pedido para Trump bombardear o Brasil a ato na Paulista
item.description: Supporters of Flávio Bolsonaro brought an inflatable missile with the message 'Trump nuke Brazil' to a rally in Paulista, calling for Donald Trump to attack Brazil. The event, dubbed 'Bloc 22,' gathered an estimated 71,900 people and featured a speech by Flávio, who praised his father Jair Bolsonaro and criticized the PT.

item.title: Esquerda faz ato pró-Lula em BH neste domingo. Confira imagens
item.description: Lula supporters held a rally at Praça da Estação in Belo Horizonte this Sunday (Oct 18), marching to Praça Raul Soares. The mobilization aims to overcome Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) first-round lead of 47.03% vs 45.16% valid votes. On Saturday, a driver plowed into a crowd at a similar event in the same area.

item.title: Veja imagens comparando os atos de Lula e Flávio na Paulista
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro held parallel rallies on Paulista Avenue within a week, drawing crowds in São Paulo.

item.title: Debate Lula x Flávio na Band: horário, data, regras e o que está em jogo no primeiro confronto direto
item.description: The first runoff debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro takes place this Sunday (10/18) on Band, after the PL candidate reversed his decision to participate. The candidates are technically tied in the polls, making the direct confrontation decisive for the electorate. BBC News Brasil will provide live coverage with data analysis and key moments after the event.

item.title: Governo acionou ANPD e MPF para apurar se Meta violou leis digitais
item.description: The government has asked the ANPD and the Federal Public Prosecutor's Office to investigate whether Meta violated digital laws in its content moderation practices. The National Secretariat for Digital Rights cites a lack of transparency in criteria for removing posts and suspending accounts, which could allow an audit of the company's automated systems. The move follows a Folha de S. Paulo report suggesting Meta was aware of restrictions that would harm Lula's re-election campaign.

item.title: TSE altera locais de votação e PT pede melhor divulgação sobre mudanças
item.description: The Brazil Ready for More coalition, led by PT with PCdoB and PV support, asked the TSE to inform each voter individually about changes to 4,352 voting locations. The move aims to ensure transparency and prevent confusion on election day. No other political parties were mentioned in the content.

item.title: PF investiga R$ 1,4 bi em transações entre amigo de Flávio e site de aposta
item.description: Federal Police are investigating 1.4 billion reais in transactions between lawyer Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, and the betting site Blaze, operated in Brazil by Foggo Entertainment.

item.title: 'Eleição no Brasil pode definir futuro da Amazônia', diz The New York Times; entenda posição do jornal
item.description: The New York Times article emphasizes that the Brazilian presidential election could determine the fate of the Amazon, with front-runner Flávio Bolsonaro advocating for opening protected areas to mining, agriculture and infrastructure, raising expert concerns over increased deforestation and risks to indigenous communities.

item.title: Quem Lula escalou para acompanhá-lo no debate da Band
item.description: President Lula is preparing for the Band debate with the support of allies like Governor Rafael Fonteles and former minister Rui Costa, focusing on the second-round electoral strategy.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula fazem atos em São Paulo, Rio e Brasília; Flávio participa de evento na Paulista
item.description: Supporters of Lula and Flávio hold rallies in São Paulo, Rio, and Brasília one week before the runoff. Artists organize pro-Lula events, while Flávio Bolsonaro joins a Paulista Avenue gathering with officials and followers. The Electoral Court reviews lawsuits questioning the legality of artistic events.

item.title: Advogado disse a Vorcaro que ele tinha o “apoio do presidente”
item.description: Messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone show that lawyer Walfrido Warde claimed Globo was trying to weaken his support for President Lula and the PT through the Banco Master acquisition by BRB. Warde alleged that the media sought to undermine Vorcaro's political backing, tied to the president, during the deal approval process. The report received no comment from the Presidency's press office.

item.title: Ato de Flávio Bolsonaro na Paulista reúne 71,9 mil pessoas, estima USP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign rally on Paulista Avenue gathered around 71,900 people at peak time, according to estimates by the USP/Cebrap Political Debate Monitor and More in Common. The event took place one week before the second round of the 2026 presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro derramou dados e números fantasiosos em sabatina no JN
item.description: In a Jornal Nacional interview, Flávio Bolsonaro pledged to respect election results but pivoted to unverified claims about Lula-era records in violence, crime, and environmental issues—some of which also occurred or were worse under his father’s government. He advocated loosening gun laws and downplayed ammunition tracking, despite expert warnings about domestic risks. His statements were widely challenged by official data and fact-checkers.

item.title: Reta final do 2º turno: Lula aposta em medidas populares para virar, e Flávio quer reforçar que manterá programas sociais
item.description: In the final stretch of Brazil's 2026 presidential runoff, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro compete for votes through debates and street mobilization in the Southeast. Polls show a technical tie with Flávio slightly ahead. Lula relies on popular measures and opposes benefit cuts, while Flávio emphasizes proposals and social programs.

item.title: “Vocês verão Jair Bolsonaro colocar a faixa no filho”, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro declared at a rally on Paulista Avenue that if elected, he will receive the presidential sash from his father, Jair Bolsonaro, while reinforcing the message of freeing Brazil from the PT a week before the runoff.

item.title: PM mobiliza equipes para atos pró-Flávio e pró-Lula simultâneos em SP
item.description: São Paulo police deployed teams to simultaneous pro-Flávio Bolsonaro and pro-Lula rallies on Avenida Paulista and Largo da Batata, reporting no incidents. Both groups received security, traffic, and mediation support to maintain public order.

item.title: Lula: campanha aciona TSE por transporte a quem teve local de votar mudado
item.description: Lula's campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE requesting free public transportation and direct communication to voters whose polling places were changed for the second round. Around 4,352 polling sections had their locations altered, affecting thousands of voters, especially in Rio de Janeiro. The measure aims to reduce voter abstention in the October 25 election.

item.title: Morte de jovem em ato pró-Lula em SE não teve motivação política, diz PT
item.description: The death of 14-year-old Jhonathan during the 'Arrastão de Lula' event in Propriá (SE) was clarified by the PT as stemming from personal conflicts, not political motives. The case involves a stabbing, with a suspect arrested. The party expressed condolences to the family and emphasized the need for a thorough investigation by authorities.

item.title: Pressionado a se posicionar, João Gomes diz ser “a favor da democracia”
item.description: At a concert in Londrina, João Gomes publicly voiced support for democracy without directly naming Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro, though the audience responded with the 'L' gesture. The artist discussed topics such as education, public healthcare, scientific research, and freedom of expression, avoiding explicit endorsement of any candidate.

item.title: Messias convoca integrantes do Exército do Lula para atos no RJ
item.description: Jorge Messias, Brazil's Attorney General, used the social media platform X to call on members of the WhatsApp group 'Army of Lula' to attend protests in Rio de Janeiro, mimicking a military mobilization order. The post reinforces Messias' expectation of a new appointment to the Supreme Federal Court, following his rejection by the Senate in April 2026.

item.title: A acusação de Manuela D’Ávila a candidato a vice-presidente da República
item.description: Manuela D'Ávila accused vice-presidential candidate Alfredo Gaspar of rape without presenting evidence, during an event in Porto Alegre. The Supreme Court had already closed an investigation into the case, finding no concrete evidence. Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign announced legal action against Manuela, as the accusation circulates among Bolsonaro supporters and intensifies the electoral race.

item.title: Flávio promete receber faixa presidencial das mãos de Bolsonaro em ato na Paulista
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) promised to receive the presidential sash from his jailed father, Jair Bolsonaro, during a campaign rally on Paulista Avenue, while the former president remains under house arrest for coup-related crimes. The event, named 'Bloquinho 22', gathered right-wing leaders and supporters who criticized the PT and Lula. Flávio announced plans to accuse his opponent during the TV debate.

item.title: Bolsonaro reúne una marea amarilla para echar a Lula y emprender el cambio en Brasil
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro intensified his campaign with a large rally on Paulista Avenue, using yellow and green flag colors to mobilize supporters against the PT. With seven days left to the vote, he remains in a tight race with Lula, who led a similar demonstration days earlier.
